name: Set Up
description: Guides first-time Grok Bot users through assembling a modest roster — a chief, a couple of project leads, some specialists — by asking one question at a time. Suited to people who have not yet decided what their bots should do; less useful once a working team already exists.

official.title: 🚦 Set Up by A-A-ron
official.description: Walks someone new to Grok Bot through building a small, intentional team: one chief, a few project leads, and specialists. Asks one question at a time...
